description: Screenshot the viewport (base64). Use FIRST when an action misbehaves: the tree cannot show overlays, canvas, occlusion or glitches. Warns about visible password inputs.

clip.description: Capture a rectangle in CSS pixels: {x, y, width, height, scale?}. Use to zoom into one element when the viewport shot is too small to read.

format.description: Image format. Default png. jpeg at quality 85 is ~5x smaller — prefer it for long pages.

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page, not just the viewport. Cannot be combined with clip.

quality.description: 0-100, jpeg/webp only (ignored for png). Default 85 for jpeg.

name: browse_screenshot
title: Screenshot the viewport
